about: Expected events, worked out by hand from SuperCollider's semantics (sclang was not run): Pdef(\x).stop stops its player whichever routine started it, and EventPatternProxy.play after a stop starts it again from its first event, on its quant (1). Tempo 1 beat per second; degrees 0, 2, 4 of the major scale are MIDI 60, 64, 67; dur 1, each note 0.8 beats long. The second routine plays Pdef(\a) at beat 1: events at beats 1 to 4. The first routine, earlier in the file, stops it at beat 4.5 (the note at beat 4 still sounds its 0.8 beats) and plays it again at beat 5.5: it starts again from degree 0 on the next beat, 6, event k at beat 6 + k, for ever (at beat 500, its event 494: degree 4; at beat 1000, event 994: degree 2). One voice throughout.
